title: A deep learning strategy to identify cell types across species from high-density extracellular recordings
primary_outputs: Cross-validated cell-type classification against feature-based baselines, with confusion matrices and accuracy versus confidence/coverage.
Transfer to expert-labeled monkey recordings from mouse-trained models; separate optotagged mouse labels from expert-inferred monkey labels.
